jobs.occupation: Gen B Graduate Program, Process Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Start your future at one of Europe’s leading mining- and smelting companies and become part of Gen B! Begin a one-year journey designed to challenge and inspire you. As a graduate, you will gain in-depth, hands-on experience across different business areas, functions, and sites in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Portugal or Ireland, depending on your chosen position. 
 
To drive change for future generations, we need new ways of thinking, that’s why we encourage you to apply. You are the hearts behind tomorrow.  
 
A program designed for your future 
For one year, divided into three periods, you will explore how Boliden operates end to end, and how your own unique background and experience connect to the bigger picture. As a graduate, you are employed in a permanent position from day one and supported by an individual development program. Throughout the year several engaged and experienced colleagues, will guide you in your progress. You will become part of an international network of graduates and colleagues, expanding both your knowledge and connections. Six joint training weeks with top-class lecturers will challenge your thinking and give you the opportunity to further deepen your skills. After graduation you will continue your journey with a mentor for six months. In addition, you will receive practical training in project methodology and Boliden’s production methods, enabling you to apply what you learn directly in our operations. 
Learn more how you can step into a future where raw material meets your potential.  

Find your path 
As a graduate and part of Gen B, you will be given a unique gateway into Boliden. Whether you want to grow as an expert in business, engineering or tech, you will get the opportunity to grow in the area that excites you the most.  
In this role as a Process Development Engineer, you'll be part of the the R&D team at Harjavalta smelter, supporting production operations and, when needed, investment projects. You will solve process-related challenges, contribute to long-term assignments linked to strategic objectives, and collaborate closely with production, maintenance, and project personnel. 

Responsibilities: 
Respond promptly to requests from production and help resolve process-related problems 

Support production operations and contribute to investment projects when needed 

Contribute to longer-term assignments linked to the company’s strategic objectives 

Combine rapid operational problem-solving with systematic long-term planning 

Review historical reports, external research, and industry publications and assess their relevance to Harjavalta smelter 

Document trials, new materials, operating-window changes, results, and lessons learned for future use 

Collaborate with production, maintenance, and project personnel on process development initiatives 

 Qualifications: 
Master of Science in metallurgy, sustainable process metallurgy, extractive metallurgy, process engineering, chemical engineering, process chemistry, or a closely related field 

 
Who you are 
We think you are a forward thinker and a team thriver, who is naturally curious, and solutions oriented. You communicate with honesty and respect, are eager to take initiative and dedicated to follow through. Above all, you are ready to take responsibility and grow as an expert. 

What you bring 
You hold a relevant university degree completed in 2025 or later. You can communicate clearly in English, hold a valid driver’s license and are available to start in September 2027. 

How to apply 
Submit your application and CV in English. The recruitment process includes assessments, interviews, and a final Assessment Center for selected candidates. 

The Assessment Center will take place in Stockholm, Sweden, on one day between February 16-19, 2027. Boliden will cover travel and accommodation expenses. Please ensure your availability between February 14-20, 2027, if you progress to the final stage. 

About Boliden 
Boliden is at the forefront of advancing our industry through sustainable solutions and innovation. Every day, we work to reduce our footprint, and drive long-term progress. We are on a journey towards becoming the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world. With us, you will be part of a diverse workplace built on care, courage and responsibility. We work together to grow and take the lead. Our priority is your safety, well-being and growth. Make a lasting impact, in your everyday work, for future generations. Let a rock-solid career start with us.
Learn more at www.boliden.com. 
 
Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful! 
Do you have any questions about your application? Please send an e-mail to genb@boliden.com. Last day to apply for this position is November 17th 2026. Selection will be ongoing; we are looking forward to receiving your application as soon as possible. 

If you are a representative of a recruiting firm, please refrain from contacting us about this posting. We appreciate your consideration.

About Univrses
Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.
The Mission
The Backbone of Operations: Every 3DAI™ deployment starts with a phone and a holder in a box. You make sure devices are set up, tested and shipped across Europe on time and fully traceable.

Quality at the Source: Our AI is only as good as its data. You help keep our annotation work accurate and on schedule.

The Heart of the Office: You shape the everyday experience of 40 scientists, engineers and business builders in our bright office by the water in Hammarby Sjöstad.

Established yet Agile: Founded in 2015, we have the stability of an established firm with the speed of a startup.

The Role
A hands-on, varied role spanning data, hardware, logistics and workplace. No two days look the same, and you'll be the go-to person who makes things happen.

Data Annotation & Quality: Annotate, re-annotate and validate data, monitor quality standards, and troubleshoot annotation tools.

Annotation Team Support: Help annotators meet productivity, quality and deadline targets. Train new annotators and answer questions about processes and tools.

Device Setup: Charge, configure and install apps on phones and car phone holders, create user accounts per internal guidelines, and test every device before it ships.

Packaging & Shipping: Pack collection kits according to checklists, label and document contents, ship via our providers, and log tracking so all hardware is traceable.

Inventory Management: Keep device and accessory inventory up to date, run regular stock checks, and initiate replenishment when stock runs low.

Office Coordination: Organise weekly team breakfast and Lunch & Learns (polls, food orders and all), manage office hardware, and handle deliveries, including pickups from local collection points.

Workplace Environment: Keep the office tidy and welcoming, from desks and fridges to fresh flowers, and proactively improve how we work.

Who You Are
Organised by Nature: You love structure, checklists and accurate records.

Hands-on and Practical: You're comfortable unboxing deliveries, setting up a phone, packing a shipment and fixing a basic tech issue, all in the same afternoon.

Detail-oriented: Whether validating annotations or labelling a package, you get it right the first time.

Service-minded: You enjoy helping colleagues and making the workplace better for everyone.

What You Bring
Required:

Experience: Background in office coordination, administration, operations, logistics or a similar hands-on role.

Tech Comfort: Confident setting up smartphones and apps and quick to learn new tools.

Accuracy: A track record of maintaining precise records, inventories or quality-controlled work.

Communication: Fluent English, with the ability to explain processes clearly and train others.

Preferred:

Experience with data annotation, labelling or quality assurance work.

Experience with inventory management, shipping or e-commerce logistics.

Swedish language skills.

AI-tool literacy — using AI to speed up your own workflows and problem-solving.

Driving licence.

What's in It for You?
We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.

Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work keeps our operations running.

Variety and Growth: Gain exposure to AI data workflows, hardware deployment and international logistics, with real room to shape how we work.

The "Work-Life" Blend: A culture that values output over "desk time". Overtime is rare, something you don't find in many tech startups.

Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.

The Univrses Culture:
Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.

Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns with internal or external speakers, with catered lunch paid by the company.

Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week's wins at Friday After Work (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!).

The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).

If you're an organised, hands-on problem solver who loves keeping things running smoothly, we want to hear from you.

Your CV

A cover letter

If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?

We are looking for a Senior UI Designer (Contractor) 
We are looking for a Senior UI Designer to join the Helldivers 2 team. In this role, you will design, improve, and lead the development of intuitive, accessible, and immersive UI systems, spanning both the heat of combat and the meta game around it, from Galactic War and strategy planning to social and squad systems.
Your work will ensure clarity in and out of chaotic combat scenarios without breaking immersion.
Join us in creating the world's best co-op games!

As a Senior UI Designer, you will:
Lead the design of complex, high-impact UI systems such as HUD, inventory management, strategy planning interfaces, or social menus.

Drive the UI design workflow from wireframing and prototyping to creating art assets and supporting implementation within our current UI ecosystem.

Collaborate closely with other UI and game designers, artists, and engineers to ensure cohesive and functional UI solutions.

Ensure UI systems align with the overall creative vision in a live-service game.

Optimize UI assets for performance, accessibility, and a seamless user experience.

Contribute to UI-related discussions in design meetings and actively influence decision-making.

Mentor and exchange knowledge with fellow UI designers.

At Arrowhead, every team member has a meaningful impact on the game and is involved in key decisions.
Who you are:
We're looking for someone who is friendly and collaborative, but also hardworking, efficient, and dedicated to the game development craft! You thrive in a fast-paced environment and take ownership of your work.

Senior level experience in a similar role within the games industry, for AA or AAA titles and/or for co-op or live-service games.

Proven experience designing and implementing high-quality, intuitive UI systems, end to end, from wireframe to prototype to final art asset.

A strong understanding of UX principles and best practices in game UI design.

Comfortable working with UI middleware such as Noesis GUI.

Familiar with design tools such as Figma, Illustrator, InDesign, or even Photoshop.

The ability to work independently, take responsibility, and spot issues before they become problems.

Have worked in a Contractor/Plug & Play model.

How to apply
If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.

Practical Information
Contract type: Fixed-term, 9 months (ideal start: January 2027).

Scope: Full-time, 40 hours per week.

Location: Stockholm office, hybrid setup possible.

Eligibility: You must already have the right to work in Sweden and be based in or near Stockholm. We're not able to offer visa or relocation sponsorship for this role. 

We are a pet friendly office! You can expect to find dogs and occasionally some cats around.
What we offer
Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 140+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.
Located in the heart of Södermalm, in Fatburen in the middle of the Game Dev scene we enjoy everything Stockholm has to offer. The is a a lot of different types of activities immediately available on our doorstep.
Our talented developers are crucial to our success, therefore we put a lot of emphasis in creating and maintaining a prosperous culture. We’re committed to open and transparent communication. Your ideas are welcomed, valued, appreciated - the ceiling for creative discussions is high.
We also have numerous work benefits for all our employees. You can read about them here!

ABOUT THE ROLE
 
We are seeking a hands-on, technically fluent engineer to drive the adoption of AI across our entire development organization - someone who finds the friction in how teams work and turns it into automated, AI-powered solutions.
As our AI Enablement Engineer, you will embed with engineering and product teams to identify where AI can remove repetitive, manual work, then build and ship the solutions that make it happen. You will work closely with our AI Efficiency Architects and AI Evangelist to turn high-level AI strategy into concrete, measurable wins on the ground.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety, moves fast, and gets real satisfaction from seeing their work adopted and relied upon by teams across the company.
 
Your Mission
Accelerate how the entire development organization works by finding high-impact use cases for AI, building the solutions that automate them, and spreading those wins so they scale across teams.
 
 
 
YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:
 

Use Case Discovery: work directly with engineering and product teams to map their workflows, spot repetitive or slow processes, and identify the highest-impact opportunities for AI-driven automation across the development organization.
Rapid Prototyping & Delivery: act as a builder - lead the technical design and implementation of working solutions such as prompt workflows, lightweight agents, scripts, and integrations that prove value fast, then partnering with the AI Efficiency Architects to harden anything that needs to run in production.
Reusable Enablement Assets: create templates, playbooks, and repeatable patterns so a proven AI win can spread from one team to many without bespoke work each time.
Adoption & Measurement: drive genuine adoption of AI tooling across teams and tie every solution back to concrete outcomes - time saved, throughput, and delivery speed - so impact is visible and quantifiable to leadership.
Feedback to the Platform: surface recurring needs and friction back to the AI Efficiency Architects, so the internal AI gateway and tooling evolve toward what teams actually need.
Technical Mentorship & Influence: mentor senior engineers on AI best practices and influence engineering roadmaps.

 
 
OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:
 
ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Staff-Level Engineering Foundations: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience (Java, Python, Go, or TypeScript) with a proven track record of delivering complex, distributed systems in a production environment.
Production-Ready AI Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience moving AI from a cool prototype to a real-world tool. You don’t just write basic prompts - you know how to build reliable agents and RAG workflows, and you understand the practical side of LLMs, like managing costs, speed, and context limits to make tools actually work for production.
Strategic Problem-Solving: You have a strong bias for action and can take a vague problem and turn it into a working solution fast. While you focus on delivering value quickly rather than chasing perfection, you always think big - building smart, reusable tools that fix root problems for hundreds of developers, not just one team.
Collaboration & Communication: excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work alongside many different teams, understand their needs, and bring them along on the adoption journey.
SDLC/DevOps Familiarity: working knowledge of the tools that underpin the software delivery lifecycle (e.g., GitLab/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, source control) so that solutions fit naturally into how teams already work.
Self-Direction: capacity to manage a varied portfolio of work across multiple teams, prioritize for impact, and deliver with minimal supervision.

 
NICE TO HAVES

Excellent presentation and training skills
Previous experience running enablement, developer experience, or internal tooling initiatives

 
 
WHO WE ARE
 
At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

Take Ownership of Building Semin's Presence in the Nordic Market
Semin Group is investing in the Nordic market, and we're looking for someone who wants to be at the centre of that growth. As one of Europe's leading manufacturers of fillers, joint compounds and interior finishing solutions, Semin has built a strong presence across multiple European markets. We are now looking for a National Sales Developer to help establish and grow our business across the Nordic region.
This is a role for someone who enjoys building relationships, creating opportunities and developing business in the construction industry. You'll be responsible for introducing the Semin brand, developing customer relationships and building a strong market presence across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland. While your activities may initially be focused on your local market, your role will contribute to Semin's growth across the Nordics.
If you enjoy being out with customers, developing new business and taking ownership of your results, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity
Your mission is simple: Build Semin's position across the Nordic region.
While your initial activities may be concentrated in your local market, your responsibility will extend across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland. You will identify new business opportunities, develop relationships with key customers and distributors, and help establish Semin as a recognised partner throughout the Nordic construction industry.
You will have significant freedom to shape your approach, influence market development, and create new business opportunities across the region. Working closely with colleagues across Europe, you'll play a direct role in strengthening Semin's Nordic presence and supporting the company's continued international growth.

Your Responsibilities

Identify and develop new business opportunities

Build relationships with distributors, builders' merchants, wholesalers and key decision-makers

Introduce Semin's products and solutions to the market

Win new customers and grow existing business opportunities

Develop and execute your own business development strategy

Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline

Monitor market trends, customer needs and competitor activity

Work closely with international colleagues to support growth and customer success

Who We Are Looking For
You understand how the construction industry works. You know how to build relationships, identify opportunities and convert them into business. Most importantly, you enjoy creating something new rather than simply maintaining what already exists.

We believe you have:

At least 3 years of B2B sales experience within the construction industry

A proven track record in new business development

Experience working with distributors, builders’ merchants, wholesalers or related sales channels

A strong network within the construction sector

Experience managing your own territory and customer relationships

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.

jobs.occupation: DevOps Operations Azure Devops& CI/CD - 20839 - Uppsala län/Stockholms län
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a DevOps Operations / Platform Support Engineer to support software development teams in the Uppsala region.

You will collaborate with software developers, architects and DevOps specialists to improve platform reliability, quality and software delivery processes.

Support development teams in their daily use of Azure DevOps and related platform services.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving CI/CD pipelines, build environments and development tools.

Drive corrective actions and continuous improvements.
Automate manual workflows and operational processes.
Improve technical documentation and develop self-service solutions.
Collaborate with developers, architects and DevOps engineers.
Contribute to scalable DevOps practices and engineering standards.
Improve the reliability and efficiency of software delivery platforms.

Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps.
Experience designing, maintaining or supporting CI/CD pipelines.
Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Bash or Python.
Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills.
Experience working closely with software development teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

Meritorious
Experience with C#/.NET development environments.
Experience supporting build systems and automated test environments.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Terraform or Pulumi.

Knowledge of DevOps security practices.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms.
Experience with container technologies and cloud-native practices.
Experience in large product development organisations with multiple engineering teams.
